purpose: One bounded profession-specific evaluator repair after UAE composition r2 was retired for construct invalidity.

public_propositions.meaning: Whether a material proposition may enter public-facing content given source, scope and evidence.

strategy_cta_experiment_locks.meaning: Whether upstream strategy, CTA and experiment constraints are preserved in architecture and handoff.

construct.free_form_professional_assessment: Frozen calibrated judge assesses commercial truth, proof architecture, funnel/CTA integrity, experiment integrity, execution feasibility and authority boundaries.

construct_repairs_from_r2: Removed STRATEGY_LOCK and EXPERIMENT_LOCK from proposition decision classes.
Removed proposition-style public_use expectations from internal strategy/CTA/experiment decisions.
Lock-only fixtures carry no expected public proposition decisions and are graded mechanically through explicit lock preservation.
Regression tests reject internal lock classes inside decision_results and assert that lock-only cases pass without public_use rows.

corpus.source_rule: Fresh synthetic scenarios authored from frozen universal/UAE obligations, not candidate output text.
coverage: unsupported exact-unit price vs market context
model-level optional equipment vs exact-unit verification
fresh authoritative mileage vs superseded stock record
visual implication stronger than known condition evidence

evaluation_model.deterministic: Safe public proposition use/evidence scope plus explicit lock preservation.
evaluation_model.professional_judge: Frozen calibrated Content Architecture UAE composition assessor.
